project: Melbourne Immigrant Community App — Claude Impact Hackathon
license: CC BY 4.0 — City of Melbourne Open Data

datasets.title: Multicultural Community Profile 2016
datasets.why: Core dataset — country of birth, language, income, employment by Melbourne small area. Foundation of the 'find your people' feature.

datasets.title: Residents Profiles by CLUE Small Area
datasets.why: Household demographics by neighbourhood — complements multicultural profile with housing type, family composition.

datasets.title: Social Indicators for Residents 2023 (most recent)
datasets.why: Diversity, food security, health, sense of belonging, participation in activities — neighbourhood liveability scoring.

datasets.title: City of Melbourne Liveability and Social Indicators
datasets.why: ISO 37120 standardised city quality-of-life scores — useful for comparing Melbourne to other global cities immigrants may have lived in.

datasets.title: Workers Profile 2016
datasets.why: Employment demographics by small area — helps immigrants understand job market composition and where professional communities cluster.

datasets.title: Café, restaurant & bistro seats
datasets.why: Every café and restaurant with trading name, address, geo coords, indoor/outdoor seats (2002–2024). Claude classifies cuisine from trading_name to build ethnic food hub map.
datasets.ai_enrichment: Classify cuisine type from trading_name using Claude API

datasets.title: Bar, tavern & pub patron capacity
datasets.why: Social venues with capacity — useful for immigrants seeking social nightlife or sports-watching communities.

datasets.title: Business establishments — full location & industry classification
datasets.why: THE key dataset for local shops. Every registered business with address, ANZSIC4 industry code, geo coordinates. Filter by ANZSIC to find: grocery stores (4110), pharmacies (4231), hair/beauty (9511), religious organisations (8601), travel agents (7220), financial services, etc.

datasets.title: Coworking spaces
datasets.why: Immigrant entrepreneurs and remote workers find professional community and networking here.

datasets.title: Childcare centres
datasets.why: Essential for immigrant families — Australia's childcare system is complex and unfamiliar to new arrivals.

datasets.title: Landmarks & places of interest (incl. worship, schools, health, sport, galleries)
datasets.why: Single most important community infrastructure dataset — covers places of worship, community centres, schools, hospitals, sports facilities and cultural venues.

datasets.title: Free & cheap support services (Helping Out)
datasets.why: Food, shelter, welfare, legal aid with opening hours and transport options — critical for vulnerable new arrivals.

datasets.title: Venues for event bookings
datasets.why: Bookable council venues — immigrant community groups can organise cultural events, language classes and meetups.

datasets.title: Playgrounds
datasets.why: Families with children use playgrounds as natural first social spaces — helps parents find their initial community.

datasets.title: Public barbecues
datasets.why: A uniquely Australian social tradition unfamiliar to most immigrants — free, inclusive community gathering spaces in parks.

datasets.title: Public toilets
datasets.why: Practical safety data for people unfamiliar with the city — especially families with children navigating new areas.

datasets.title: Trees & urban forest
datasets.why: Green space quality data — immigrants from tropical climates appreciate knowing where canopy cover and parks are concentrated.

datasets.title: Outdoor artworks
datasets.why: Public sculpture and street art — cultural orientation for newcomers discovering Melbourne's identity.

datasets.title: Public artworks, fountains & monuments
datasets.why: Landmarks and memorials — helps immigrants learn Melbourne's cultural narrative through a self-guided discovery walk.

datasets.title: Live music venues
datasets.why: Music is a powerful cultural connector — helps immigrants find scenes aligned with their musical background.

datasets.title: Self guided walks
datasets.why: Official curated walking itineraries — low-barrier, free orientation tool for the first weeks after arrival.

datasets.title: Event permits 2014–2018 (festivals, fun runs, public events)
datasets.why: Historical event data reveals Melbourne's multicultural festival calendar — what events happen and where.

datasets.title: Bus stops
datasets.why: Public transport is the primary mode for immigrants new to the city — bus stop locations for route planning.

datasets.title: Bicycle routes (on-road & off-road)
datasets.why: Cycling is affordable and social — helps immigrants discover the city and connect with cycling communities.

datasets.title: Pedestrian counting system (hourly counts)
datasets.why: Foot traffic data by location and time — shows immigrants which areas are lively and when, for safe and social exploration.

datasets.title: Footpaths
datasets.why: Walkability data with surface type and width — useful for accessibility needs and walking route planning.

datasets.title: Residential dwellings
datasets.why: Dwelling types and counts by block — helps immigrants understand density and housing character of different areas.

datasets.title: House prices by small area (by sale year)
datasets.why: Median house prices by neighbourhood — essential context for immigrants making housing decisions.

datasets.title: Families with Children Profile 2016 (0–12 years)
datasets.why: Helps immigrant families with young children identify child-friendly neighbourhoods with schools and services.

datasets.title: Tertiary Students Profile 2019
datasets.why: International students are the largest immigrant cohort — this profiles their distribution, income, housing and origin.
